title: 谁是强者
venue: 北京人民艺术剧院 / Beijing People’s Art Theatre
creator: 梁秉堃 / Liang Bingkun
desc: 林兆华继《为了幸福干杯》之后独立执导的现实题材话剧。作品围绕改革开放初期企业生产、权力关系与“关系网”展开，1981年秋冬在北京人艺排练并演出。
endesc: A contemporary social drama independently directed by Lin Zhaohua after A Toast to Happiness. Set amid the early reform era, it examines production, power and the “relationship network”; it was rehearsed and staged at Beijing People’s Art Theatre in autumn and winter 1981.

synopsis: 新华棉纺织厂厂长袁志成在改革开放初期试图扩建新车间，却因电力扩容、送礼和干部安排等问题遭遇以倪科长为代表的“关系网”阻挠。袁志成拒绝以权谋私，最终在上级机关和市纪委介入后解决供电问题。
synopsis_en: Yuan Zhicheng, director of Xinhua Cotton Mill, tries to expand production during the early reform era but is blocked by a “relationship network” involving power allocation, gifts and cadre appointments. He refuses to use influence for private gain, and the electricity dispute is eventually resolved after intervention by higher authorities and the municipal discipline-inspection body.
background: 林兆华在回忆中将《谁是强者》列为《绝对信号》之前独立执导的两部作品之一。中国作家网刊载的《让历史告诉未来——记话剧〈谁是强者〉的诞生》记述了1981年秋冬的排练演出，并记录于是之在剧本创作过程中长期参与讨论、修改和定稿。
bg_en: In Lin’s recollections, Who Is the Strongest? is one of the two productions he independently directed before Absolute Signal. A China Writers Association account records the autumn–winter 1981 rehearsals and performances and describes Yu Shizhi’s extensive involvement in discussing, revising and finalizing the script.

title: 绝对信号
venue: 北京人民艺术剧院；首都剧场一楼排练厅等 / Beijing People’s Art Theatre; rehearsal spaces at the Capital Theatre
creator: 高行健 / Gao Xingjian
desc: 与高行健合作的关键作品。以列车、隧道与人物心理为核心，把小空间转化为高密度的心理与行动空间；北京人艺官方资料将其列为首开中国小剧场话剧先河的作品。
endesc: A landmark collaboration with Gao Xingjian. The production transformed a small performance space into a dense field of action and psychological tension, and is identified by Beijing People's Art Theatre as a pioneering work in Chinese small-theatre drama.
quote: “舞台上没有不可表现的东西。”
q_en: “There is nothing that cannot be represented on stage.”

synopsis: 待业青年黑子被车匪胁迫参与扒车越货，在列车上遇到昔日同学小号、恋人蜜蜂和老车长；危急关头，几个人作出不同选择，列车避免事故。
synopsis_en: Unemployed youth Heizi is coerced into a robbery on a freight train. Encounters with an old friend, his former lover and an experienced conductor force the characters to make choices under pressure.
background: 作品在传统现实主义剧场之外寻找新的时空组织和表演方式。林兆华回忆，排练与演出经历了较长的剧本讨论和现实阻力。1982年9月19日的内部试演通常被视为中国当代小剧场戏剧的重要坐标。
bg_en: The production sought new spatial and performative forms beyond conventional realism. Lin later recalled prolonged script discussions and institutional resistance; the 19 September 1982 internal showing is widely treated as a landmark of Chinese contemporary small-theatre drama.
revivals: 档案资料显示后续曾多次进入回顾、纪念性演出与研究。

venue: 北京人民艺术剧院 / Beijing People's Art Theatre；Thalia Theater, Hamburg

desc: 高行健作品。1985年，林兆华受德国汉堡塔利亚剧院邀请，为德国演员排演《野人》，这是他第一次赴海外排戏。导演自述将这部作品视为一次重要的形式解放。

synopsis_en: Drawing on playwright Liu Jinyun’s rural experience, the play follows Gou Er Ye’s life amid conflicts over land, dignity and historical change.

venue: 南郊旧厂房/蜂窝煤厂等非传统空间；中央实验话剧院与工作室联合出品 / Former industrial space; co-produced by Central Experimental Theatre and the Studio
creator: 鲁迅 / Lu Xun（原作）
desc: 导演自述认为它严格说来不是单纯“排”出来的戏，而是演员以鲁迅《故事新编》为蓝本进行共同即兴练习，再由导演剪裁形成演出结构。
endesc: Lin describes it not as a conventional director-led production, but as a collective improvisational process: actors worked from Lu Xun's Old Tales Retold, then Lin edited the material into a performance structure.
quote: “形式本身就是内容。”
q_en: “Form itself is content.”

synopsis_en: Drawing on Lu Xun’s retellings of myths, legends and history, the production foregrounded the performers’ immediate acts of narration and creation.
background: 由中央实验话剧院与林兆华戏剧工作室合作出品，属日中合作项目；演出空间使用旧厂房并置入大量煤。 / A Sino-Japanese collaboration co-produced by Central Experimental Theatre and the Studio, staged in a former industrial building with large quantities of coal.
bg_en: An industrial space was transformed with coal piles; performers worked in a semi-improvised mode, turning Lu Xun’s texts into a live narrative combining storytelling, traditional theatre and modern dance.
